full_judgment: 09. It appears from the materials on record that total land appertaining to C.S. khatian No. 891, S.A khatian No. 810, R.S khatian No. 395, S.A. plot No. 4643 is measuring an area of .0812 acre. Admittedly, the said land originally belonged to Kazimuddin. Kazimuddin, on 05.10.1983, transferred .0350 acre of land to Rabbel Ali. Thereafter, he sold .0330 acre of land to plaintiff Alauddin by another sale deed dated 16.11.1983. According to the plaintiff, Robbel Ali sold .0080 acre of land to plaintiff Alauddin by a kabala deed dated 28.02.1984. Thus, the plaintiff acquired title in .0410 acre of land out of the total land of the disputed plot. The plaintiff claimed title in the suit land and prayed for recovery of khas possession in respect of .0080 acre of land out of the total land.
